configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the server name visible in the game browser (up to 100 characters)

configurationFields.label: Server Mission/Scenario
configurationFields.description: Sets the server mission/scenario. Official missions/scenarios are included in the dropdown (note that some may only be available with the Experimental server). To use another mission/scenario, select "Custom" and set the Custom Mission/Scenario Name

options.{10B8582BAD9F7040}Missions/Scenario01_In: Operation Omega 01: Over The Hills And Far Away
options.{D1647575BCEA5A05}Missions/Scenario03_Vi: Operation Omega 03: Light In The Dark

configurationFields.label: Custom Mission/Scenario Name
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom mission/scenario for the server. "Custom" type must be selected under Server Mission/Scenario and any required mods specified under Load Mods

configurationFields.label: Make Server Public
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be visible in the in-game browser

configurationFields.label: Public IP Selection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether GSCS should automatically select the public IP advertised for the server, or whether it should use the IP set under Server Public IP

configurationFields.label: Server Public IP
configurationFields.description: Sets the public IP advertised for the server, if "Manual" is selected as the Public IP Selection Mode. Useful if the host network has multiple public IPs, or the server is behind a public proxy

configurationFields.label: Enable Crossplay
configurationFields.description: If enabled, crossplay between PC, Xbox and PlayStation clients will be possible

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Only use alphanumeric, dash or underscore characters. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Admins
configurationFields.description: Sets a whitelist of IdentityIDs and/or SteamIDs of server admins. Maximum 20 IDs. Listed admins won't need to use the Admin Password, and those listed by IdentityID can use the priority queue to join the server. Format is "ID","ID"

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for admin access to the server. Only use alphanumeric, dash or underscore characters. Maximum 32 characters. Default is a strong random password

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's BattlEye RCON

configurationFields.label: Maximum RCON Clients
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of clients that can connect to RCON at the same time. Note that GSCS itself takes one slot

configurationFields.label: Server Player Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Synchronise Player Count
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the list of players on the server is sent to the GameAPI along with the server's heartbeat, to fix the discrepancy between the real and reported number of players on the server

configurationFields.label: Navmesh Streaming Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the navmesh streamimg mode. Enabled components will be streamed, disabled components will be loaded into memory (slightly increasing performance, significantly increasing memory use). If "Disable specific components" is selected, specify them under Disabled Navmesh Components

configurationFields.label: Disabled Navmesh Components
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of navmesh components to disable, if "Disable specific components" is selected under Navmesh Streaming Mode. Format is "Component","Component"

configurationFields.label: Load Mods
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated [list of mods](https://reforger.armaplatform.com/workshop) required by clients, which will be downloaded and activated on join. Each mod entry must be in valid JSON format. Name and version are optional. Example: {"modId":"591AF5BDA9F7CE8B","name":"Capture & Hold","version":"1.0.3"}

configurationFields.label: Enable Mod Verification
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will verify the integrity of all installed mods. If any corrupted mods are found, the server will shut down and log the corrupted files

configurationFields.label: Enable Mod Repair
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will verify the integrity of all installed mods. If any corrupted mods are found, they will be repaired automatically. If the repair fails, the server will shut down

configurationFields.label: Player Save Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the default period for saving players for both Online and Local storage (player save can still be requested on demand)

configurationFields.label: Server FPS Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the server FPS. Recommended to be in the range of 60 to 120 so that the server does not use all available resources

configurationFields.label: Maximum View Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's maximum view distance

configurationFields.label: Network View Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's maximum network streaming range of replicated entities

configurationFields.label: Minimum Grass Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's minimum grass distance. 0 = no distance forced. Otherwise minimum 50, maximum 150

configurationFields.label: Disable Third Person
configurationFields.description: If enabled, clients will be forced to use the first-person view

configurationFields.label: Enable Fast Validation
configurationFields.description: If enabled, matching validation of map entities and components loaded on a client when it joins will be done with minimum information. Always enable for a public server!

configurationFields.label: Enable BattlEye
configurationFields.description: If set, BattlEye anti-cheat will be enabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Freeze Check Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period to forcefully crash on application freeze. 0 = completely disable detection

configurationFields.label: Freeze Check Override
configurationFields.description: Overrides the server's behaviour when a freeze is detected

options.minidump: Generate minidump and keep running (Windows only)

configurationFields.label: Disable VON UI
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be forced to not have the VON (Voice Over Network) UI

configurationFields.label: Disable VON Direct Speech UI
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be forced to not have the VON (Voice Over Network) Direct Speech UI

configurationFields.label: Enable Cross-Faction VON Transmission
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be allowed to transmit on other factions' radios. Otherwise, players' radios will be listen-only

configurationFields.label: Mission Header
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of settings that will overwrite a mission/scenario's SCR_MissionHeaderCampaign. Example: "m_iPlayerCount":"64","m_eEditableGameFlags":"6"

configurationFields.label: Auto Save Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval at which automatic saves are created, if possible for the current mission. 0 = disable autosave

configurationFields.label: Save Retention Number
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of save points to keep for the current mission, if Auto Save Interval is enabled

configurationFields.label: Load Session Save
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will automatically load the latest available save point on start

configurationFields.label: Keep Session Save
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will keep the playthrough save points after the mission is finished

configurationFields.label: Persistence System Hive ID
configurationFields.description: Sets a number to identify each hive (server) when they share the same persistence database. Used for separating UUIDs for save game data

configurationFields.label: Persistence System Databases Overrides
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated named objects representing an override of the system configuration-provided databases or the addition of a new one. Valid child properties are 'preset' and 'options' and must be in valid JSON format. [More information](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_Reforger:Server_Config#databases). Example: "webapi": { "preset": "{0123456789ABCDEF}Configs/Systems/Persistence/Database/JsonWebApi.conf" }

configurationFields.label: Persistence System Storages Overrides
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated named objects representing an override of the system configuration-provided storages. Valid child properties are 'database' and must be in valid JSON format. [More information](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_Reforger:Server_Config#storages). Example: "session": { "database": "webapi" }

configurationFields.label: AI Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of AIs. -1 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Disable AI
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will prevent initialization and ticking of AIWorld and its components, completely disabling AI functionality

configurationFields.label: Slot Reservation Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets how long the backend and server will reserve a slot for a kicked player. 5 = effectively diabled (given the value is the same as for a normal disconnect)

configurationFields.label: Disable Crash Reporter
configurationFields.description: If set, the automatic server-side [Crash Report](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_Reforger:Crash_Report) will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Mods Required By Default
configurationFields.description: If set, the default value for 'required' will be overridden for all mods

configurationFields.label: Disable Server Shutdown
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will not automatically shutdown if connection to the backend is lost as a result of room requests errors. Other causes like corrupted configs will still shutdown the server

configurationFields.label: Join Queue Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the limit for how many people can be in the server's join queue at one time. 0 = queue disabled

configurationFields.label: Log Statistics
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server logs performance statistics every second or such other period set under "Statistics Logging Interval"

configurationFields.label: Statistics Logging Inverval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval for logging of performance statistics, if "Log Statistics" is enabled

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Startup Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional startup parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Release Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the release version of the server to install. Update the server after switching versions. The corresponding client version must also be used
